jana: Heads-up: we've added two new Dedicated A10G pools for targeted cost-sensitive inference: `dedicated-a10g-eu-north-1b` and `dedicated-a10g-ap-south-1a`.

jana: Initial capacity: eu-north-1b = 24 cards, ap-south-1a = 16 cards. We're treating these as pilot pools and will scale on demand over the next 48h. If you need guaranteed capacity, reserve now.

evan: What's the default burst policy on these? We had noisy-tenant incidents last month.

jana: Default cross-tenant burst cap: 15% of pool capacity (effective immediately for these pools). Note: existing Reserved allocations are prioritized and not impacted. Customers can opt into higher burst during reservation with `--allow-burst` but that requires an approval flow.

ops-team: Approval flow? Who reviews burst requests?

jana: Ops + SRE review for any request with `--allow-burst=true`. We want to minimize tail contention during pilot.

pricing: Need guidance for quoting. Any delta vs our H100/Dedicated pricing?

jana: High-level: expected unit cost ~40-60% lower than similar H100 offerings for int8 workloads. Recommend we position A10G for embeddings, short-turn gen, and batches where cost matters; H100 still for sub-20ms p99 low-latency use cases. Evan, can you post a short pricing note and blurb for AE kit?

evan: Will do. ETA 3pm PST. I'll include a short FAQ on quantization caveats.

jana: Routing note: these pools are added with `region_affinity=preferred` and `cost_tier=low`. No automatic migration of existing reservations. Global routing will only consider these when local pools are saturated or routing policy explicitly prefers cost.

ops-team: Autoscale defaults for these pools?

sre-bot: Autoscaling policy applied: min_replicas=1, scale_step=2, cooldown=180s, max_burst_replicas=4 (subject to burst cap). Metrics: scale triggers on 75% GPU utilization sustained for 60s.

deploy-bot: Network tuning rollout scheduled for eu-north-1b. Expect brief (1-2m) stream reconnects during warmup for active sessions.

ops-team: We'll add a check to warn users with long-lived streams before routing to these pools.

jana: Reservation CLI example:
```
# reserve 2 cards for 14d in eu-north-1b without burst
rw-cli dedicated reserve --pool dedicated-a10g-eu-north-1b --count 2 --duration 14d --allow-burst=false
```

jana: If you need to request burst opt-in for a customer:
```
rw-cli dedicated reserve --pool dedicated-a10g-ap-south-1a --count 4 --duration 30d --allow-burst=true --approval-team ops
```

pricing: Thanks, will fold that into the AE kit.

jana: Internal runbook & perf notes: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-a10g-pilot (internal). Post-launch watch: 48h, team on call schedule linked in the runbook.

evan: Quick perf callout: A10G int8 paths show 2x cost reduction for common decoder models at 2-4k context, but expect 10-30% higher p99 tail vs H100 for >8k tokens. I'll add to the FAQ.

ops-team: Noted. We'll monitor p99 and cache hit rates closely.

jana: TL;DR: pilot A10G pools live in eu-north-1b and ap-south-1a, limited burst cap 15% by default, reservations unaffected, approval required for higher burst. Ping me or ops-team for access/questions. We'll post a short utilization summary after 48h.
